signals.title: ChatGPT updates GPT-5.6 Sol and expands GPT-5.6 Luna while explicitly leaving Work and Codex unchanged
signals.title_zh: ChatGPT 更新 GPT-5.6 Sol 并扩大 GPT-5.6 Luna，同时明确 Work 与 Codex 不变
signals.observedChange: OpenAI updated GPT-5.6 Sol for Plus and Pro with a thought-amount control and is making GPT-5.6 Luna the Free and Go default, while explicitly scoping the release to ChatGPT and excluding Work and Codex.
signals.observedChange_zh: OpenAI 为 Plus 与 Pro 更新 GPT-5.6 Sol 并增加思考量控制，同时将 GPT-5.6 Luna 设为 Free 与 Go 默认；发布范围明确限定为 ChatGPT，不改变 Work 与 Codex。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot announces Kimi K3 with enterprise policy gating, then temporarily pauses rollout during a GitHub Actions incident
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 宣布 Kimi K3 并设置企业策略门禁，随后因 GitHub Actions 事件临时暂停推出
signals.observedChange: GitHub announced Kimi K3 across Copilot surfaces, hosted on Fireworks AI and disabled by default for Business and Enterprise until administrators enable its policy; an editor note states rollout was temporarily paused while GitHub mitigated an Actions incident.
signals.observedChange_zh: GitHub 宣布 Kimi K3 覆盖多种 Copilot 表面，由 Fireworks AI 托管；Business 与 Enterprise 默认关闭，需管理员启用策略。官方编辑说明同时记录因 GitHub Actions 事件临时暂停推出。

signals.title: Gemini CLI v0.54.0 packages session-continuity, transport-security and history-integrity fixes
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI v0.54.0 集中发布会话连续性、传输安全与历史完整性修复
signals.observedChange: The v0.54.0 release includes session-ID rotation on model fallback, HTTPS enforcement for Google credential transport, history filtering corrections and other runtime fixes accumulated since the prior stable line.
signals.observedChange_zh: v0.54.0 包含模型回退时轮换 Session ID、Google 凭据传输强制 HTTPS、历史过滤修正及其他运行时修复。

signals.title: Codex sends credential-scoped model routing hints to backend HTTP, compaction and WebSocket paths
signals.title_zh: Codex 在受凭据范围约束的 HTTP、压缩与 WebSocket 路径发送模型路由提示
signals.observedChange: A new x-codex-routing-hint carries request model and optional service tier across Responses, remote compaction and WebSocket prewarm paths, but is intentionally omitted for API-key and provider-specific credential paths.
signals.observedChange_zh: 新增 x-codex-routing-hint，在 Responses、远程压缩与 WebSocket 预热路径传递请求模型及可选服务层级，同时明确排除 API Key 与特定 Provider 凭据路径。

signals.title: Codex fixes subagent MCP startup status so deferred cached servers cannot leave the UI permanently running
signals.title_zh: Codex 修复子 Agent MCP 启动状态，避免延迟缓存 Server 让界面永久显示运行中
signals.observedChange: Active subagent threads now clear configured MCP startup expectations so visible startup state is driven by actual notifications; primary threads and side conversations retain configured-server tracking.
signals.observedChange_zh: 活跃子 Agent Thread 现在清除预配置 MCP 启动预期，使可见启动状态由实际通知驱动；主 Thread 与侧会话仍保留配置 Server 跟踪。

signals.title: Codex consolidates deferred environment provisioning into report-and-materialize lifecycle APIs
signals.title_zh: Codex 将延迟环境 Provisioning 收敛为报告与实体化生命周期 API
signals.observedChange: EnvironmentManager removes separate deferred registration and readiness APIs in favor of provisioning-status reporting plus explicit pending-environment materialization, with tests for invalid reports, duplicate materialization and conflicts.
signals.observedChange_zh: EnvironmentManager 移除独立的延迟注册与就绪发布 API，改用 Provisioning 状态报告加待定环境显式实体化，并覆盖无效报告、重复实体化与冲突测试。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents Python isolates resumed-run mutable lists by copying state adopted from RunState
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents Python 通过复制 RunState 列表隔离恢复运行的可变状态
signals.observedChange: A resumed run now works on copies of mutable lists adopted from RunState instead of sharing the original list objects, tightening isolation between persisted resume state and subsequent execution mutations.
signals.observedChange_zh: 恢复运行现在对从 RunState 接管的可变列表使用副本，而不再共享原列表对象，从而强化持久化恢复状态与后续执行变更之间的隔离。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents Python preserves required program item IDs for OpenAI conversation sessions
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents Python 为 OpenAI Conversation Session 保留必需的 Program Item ID
signals.observedChange: Conversation-session handling was corrected to preserve required program item identifiers, protecting identity continuity across session-backed agent runs.
signals.observedChange_zh: Conversation Session 处理被修正为保留必需的 Program Item 标识符，以维护基于 Session 的 Agent 运行身份连续性。

signals.title: Google ADK bounds both entry count and bytes read from uploaded skill ZIP archives
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 同时限制上传 Skill ZIP 的条目数量与读取字节数
signals.observedChange: Skill archive ingestion now enforces bounds on archive entry count and bytes read, reducing resource-exhaustion exposure at the skill package boundary.
signals.observedChange_zh: Skill Archive 摄入现在限制归档条目数量与读取字节数，降低 Skill 包边界的资源耗尽风险。

signals.title: Google ADK redacts database passwords from session-service errors and logs
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 从 Session Service 错误与日志中脱敏数据库密码
signals.observedChange: Session service failure handling now redacts database passwords from errors and log output, strengthening observability without leaking connection secrets.
signals.observedChange_zh: Session Service 失败处理现在从错误与日志输出中脱敏数据库密码，在保持可观测性的同时避免泄露连接秘密。

signals.title: A2A corrects its v1 migration guide to match normative ProtoJSON stream names and serializable fields
signals.title_zh: A2A 修正 v1 迁移指南，使其匹配规范 ProtoJSON Stream 名称与可序列化字段
signals.observedChange: The migration guide now uses canonical statusUpdate and artifactUpdate ProtoJSON names and removes nonexistent task timestamp and configId claims that could cause conforming stream updates to be ignored.
signals.observedChange_zh: 迁移指南现使用规范的 statusUpdate 与 artifactUpdate ProtoJSON 名称，并移除不存在的 Task Timestamp 与 configId 声明，避免合规 Stream Update 被错误忽略。

signals.title: OneDayAgent proposes a long-horizon harness with bounded subtasks, execution memory and final-deliverable verification and repair
signals.title_zh: OneDayAgent 提出包含有界子任务、执行记忆与最终交付验证修复的长周期 Harness
signals.observedChange: The paper presents a backend-agnostic long-horizon harness that manages goal and state persistence, context pressure, bounded subtask decomposition, and final deliverable verification across 104 AgentIF-OneDay tasks.
signals.observedChange_zh: 论文提出面向多 Backend 的长周期 Harness，联合管理目标与状态持久化、上下文压力、有界子任务拆解及最终交付验证，并在 104 个 AgentIF-OneDay 任务上评估。

signals.title: Argus describes a durable role-owned runtime with verification-gated self-evolution and operator escalation points
signals.title_zh: Argus 描述具有角色所有权、验证门禁自演化与操作员升级点的持久运行时
signals.observedChange: Argus separates stable user intent from operational objectives and lets Manager, Planner, Engineer and Reviewer operate bounded missions over durable state; memories, skills and routing decisions are admitted only after role-owned review and available task-native verification.
signals.observedChange_zh: Argus 将稳定用户意图与操作目标分离，由 Manager、Planner、Engineer、Reviewer 在持久状态上执行有界 Mission；Memory、Skill 与路由决策仅在角色 Review 及可用任务原生验证后进入持久运行时。

signals.title: A Microsoft Azure production study characterizes agentic workflows as fragmented CPU-GPU orchestration with role-sensitive resource demand
signals.title_zh: Microsoft Azure 生产研究将 Agentic Workflow 刻画为碎片化 CPU-GPU 编排与角色敏感资源需求
signals.observedChange: The study combines Microsoft Azure production traces with controlled open-source framework experiments to characterize tool and orchestration fragmentation, bursty CPU demand, GPU multiplexing and role-aware scheduling implications.
signals.observedChange_zh: 研究结合 Microsoft Azure 生产 Trace 与开源框架受控实验，刻画工具与编排碎片化、突发 CPU 需求、GPU 多路复用及角色感知调度的架构影响。

signals.title: Active-SWE benchmarks coding agents on proactive multi-bug discovery and repair without issue-report guidance
signals.title_zh: Active-SWE 在没有 Issue Report 指引时评测 Coding Agent 主动发现并修复多 Bug 的能力
signals.observedChange: Active-SWE expands coding-agent evaluation beyond reactive issue-driven repair to 1,663 proactive bug-fixing tasks across six bug categories and eight languages, using a difficulty-aware construction pipeline and dual-track evaluation.
signals.observedChange_zh: Active-SWE 将 Coding Agent 评测从依赖 Issue 的被动修复扩展到 1,663 个主动 Bug 修复任务，覆盖 6 类 Bug 与 8 种语言，并使用难度感知构造与双轨评测。
